    tip_rack_300 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 2)
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 4)
    dest_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 5)

    # Load instruments
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tip_rack_20])
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack_300])

    # Define liquids
    water = protocol.define_liquid(name="water", description="Water", display_color="#0000FF")
    samples = {}
    for i in range(1, 25):
        samples[i] = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"sample {i}", description=f"Sample {i}", display_color=f"#{i:06X}")

    # Load water into reservoir
    reservoir_well = reservoir["A1"]
    reservoir_well.load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=5000)

    # Load sample liquids into source plate in order
    # Volumes from normalisation (ul)
    sample_volumes = {
        1: 5.88,
        2: 4.17,
        3: 11.36,
        4: 7.46,
        5: 2.38,
        6: 5.26,
        7: 15.15,
        8: 3.33,

        19: 7.81,
        20: 4.55,
        21: 12.82,
        22: 2.86,
        23: 5.43,
        24: 8.62
    }
    diluent_volumes = {
        1: 44.12,
        2: 45.83,
        3: 38.64,
        4: 42.54,
        5: 47.62,
        6: 44.74,
        7: 34.85,
        8: 46.67,
        9: 43.59,
        10: 41.67,
        11: 45.05,
        12: 40.91,
        13: 47.37,
        14: 43.06,
        15: 39.58,
        16: 46.15,
        17: 44.32,
        18: 30.0,
        19: 42.19,
        20: 45.45,
        21: 37.18,
        22: 47.14,
        23: 44.57,
        24: 41.38
    }

    # Load each sample into its source well in order
    for i in range(1, 25):
        src_well = source_plate.wells()[i-1]
        src_well.load_liquid(
            liquid=samples[i],
            volume=sample_volumes[i]

    # Perform transfers
    for i in range(1, 25):
        vol_sample = sample_volumes[i]
